account_poll_component.caveat: Local controlled benchmarks. HTTP timings exclude Internet latency. Client timings exclude network and DOM rendering; callback/write counts are deterministic.

browser_cohort.scope: Two real isolated Chromium browsers, one desktop and one mobile emulation; same show pool, seed and plans as prior live cohort. Service worker and HTTP cache enabled; no API mocking or interception. New backend normal startup/background enabled and already warm from preliminary runs; old backend no-background diagnostic mode. Timings are descriptive local observations, not a controlled provider or production capacity benchmark. The new comparison action additionally checks matrix tooltips in both modes; touch uses tap, desktop hover, after scroll settles.

conditions.worker_network_observation: Worker targets are attached after discovery; earliest install fetches can precede attachment.
conditions.notes: Browser cohort is actual local concurrency, not a claim of 10,000 rendered users. SW deliveries and Cache Storage hits are reported separately. No-new-request actions are observed reuse, not invented cache hits.

browser_cohort.backend_interval_caveat: snapshot interval also includes normal background work; not purely browser-caused provider traffic

linux_definitions.proc_stat: first8 columns user,nice,system,idle,iowait,irq,softirq,steal; aggregate counters in USER_HZ; steal is involuntary wait. The denominator excludes guest and guest_nice.
linux_definitions.quota: cpu.max MAX/PERIOD is maximum bandwidth, not a dedicated-core reservation.
linux_definitions.psi: some is time with at least some tasks stalled; full is time with all non-idle cgroup tasks stalled. System-level CPUfull is undefined and reported zero.
